prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1039; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Conroe, Texas, when another vehicle moved into the space beside me and its side struck my car. I had checked my mirror and signaled before moving over, so I did not expect the contact. Both cars pulled to the shoulder, and I stayed where I was until the other driver and I could speak. I have been the named driver on this policy for the entire time I have held it, and I am the person who was behind the wheel at the moment of impact. Since the collision I have described the sequence the same way to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to my doctor. The next morning my neck was stiff and the pain ran into my shoulders, and I was later diagnosed with whiplash. I am providing this account so the claim can be reviewed.
